item.title: Diving for a Coin
item.description: Through the years, children from the sea community of Bajau have become a constant presence at the Isabela City wharf in Basilan, like the boys in this picture taken Thursday morning (11 December 2025), diving for coins thrown by travelers from arriving or departing passenger boats. MindaNews photo by JULES L. BENITEZ

item.title: Human Rights Day Rally
item.description: Militant groups in Davao City call for justice, human rights and a just and lasting peace during a rally on International Human Rights Day on Wednesday (10 December 2025). MindaNews photo by CAROLYN O. ARGUILLAS

item.title: Philippine eagles retain rare genetics, offering boost to conservation efforts
item.description: GENERAL SANTOS CITY (MindaNews / 11 December) — Captive Philippine eagles (Pithecophaga jefferyi) preserve all known maternal genetic lineages of the critically endangered national bird, a new study by the University of the Philippines Mindanao, the Philippine Genome Center (PGC), and the Philippine Eagle Foundation (PEF) shows.
